description:
When a base decays once the Tool Cupboard runs out, piece or layer by layer. The decay page's maths (https://rust.wiki/calculators/decay): with no upkeep, an outside piece goes from full
health to nothing in 1 h (twig), 3 h (wood), 5 h (stone), 8 h (sheet metal) or 12 h (armoured); inside pieces
decay at a tenth of that. `destroyed_in_hours` counts from now (upkeep first). For `layers`, each layer behind
the outer one decays at 10% until the one in front is gone, then at full speed. Vanilla server defaults.

grade.description: Building grade: twig, wood, stone, metal, hqm.

inside.description: True = the piece is inside the base (decays at 10% speed).

layers.description: Optional honeycomb: comma-separated grades from the outside in (max 6).

upkeep_hours.description: Hours of upkeep left in the Tool Cupboard.
